Priya Shah: Hey finance — BrightFrame (reseller pilot) asked for a temporary reseller rate ceiling for Q4. They want 40% off list for the first 3 months to accelerate onboarding. ARR on the commit is ~$120k, hosted API only. Can we approve as a one-off? Need deal desk ok + accounting guidance on revenue recognition.
Alex Kim: quick q: is the $120k the committed ARR or expected spend? and is this discount across all SKUs or a single sku?
Priya Shah: committed ARR = $120k (12 month), hosted API only. Discount requested applies to usage on resale seats for first 3 months, then revert to standard channel pricing.
Jordan Lee: FYI revenue recognition angle — a 40% upfront concession looks like a customer credit. If we treat as a one-off discount applied up front we need to decide whether to (a) report as reduction of transaction price in month of application or (b) capitalize as contract liability and amortize. Recommend amortize the concession over the 12 month term unless partner prepays.
Sam Torres: legal: we'll need a reseller addendum signed (reseller pilot terms + restrictions). Also confirm IP/marketing co-fund if marketing funds are involved.
BillingBot: calc snippet:
``
list_monthly = 120000 / 12 = 10000
3mo_discount = 0.40 * 10000 * 3 = 12000
amortized_monthly_impact = 12000 / 12 = 1000
```
Contract id placeholder: BF-2026-Q4-PILOT
Priya Shah: thanks JBot. Jordan — partner cannot prepay. They asked for the concession because they need margin to sign initial reseller contracts. Could we do amortized credit?
Jordan Lee: amortize is fine. Alternative: convert to a time-limited onboarding credit (credit balance applied monthly) rather than a percentage discount. That keeps revenue recognition cleaner; still needs GL mapping.
Alex Kim: from pricing policy perspective, suggest we cap approved discount to 35% for pilots unless sales shows exec signoff. Condition: signed reseller addendum + recorded acceptance of standard SLA. Also require that marketing co-fund 50% of onboarding credits if BrightFrame wants >30% discount.
Priya Shah: BrightFrame says no prepay and no marketing co-fund. They can sign addendum quickly. They're asking for economics to move the deal this week.
Sam Torres: legal can fast-track addendum but we need a PO or signed MSA amendment.
Jordan Lee: finance decision: approve 30% one-off onboarding credit (translate to $9,000 credit over first 3 months) amortized over 12mo. Anything above 30% needs finance director approval. I can draft the GL entries: DR ContraRevenue $9,000 / CR DeferredRevenue $9,000 then amortize monthly.
Alex Kim: +1 to Jordan's route. Escalate to Finance Director (cc @Maya) if Sales insists on 40%.
Priya Shah: I'll tell sales to accept 30% onboarding credit amortized. I'll loop in Maya for sign-off if they push back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam Torres: noted, will queue the addendum.
Alex Kim: tagging for transparency: @Jordan Lee please post the GL mapping in billing ops doc after we finalize.
Priya Shah: will do. Closing thread unless any objections. :white_check_mark:
